title: To Paint!
description: Adds useful vanilla brushes to paint straight in the world!
body:
## Brushes
### Mod adds useful brushes of all colors to paint different blocks in the world like wool, carpets, beds and etc.
You can make them from usual brush and some dye and clear from dye with water bucket in crafting or clicking on cauldron with water.
Also adds a colorful brush to randomize paint.
## Colorful Cauldrons
### There are also cauldrons to paint a brush in any dye which you need.
You can make this cauldrons by adding some dye to cauldron full of water.
